summary.text: James Kelly is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 35, in the November 3, 2026 general election. He advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026.

paragraphs.text: James Kelly was a Republican candidate for New Hampshire House of Representatives Hillsborough 27 in the November 6, 2018 general election, in which Michelle St. John and incumbent Jim Belanger won the district's two seats, according to Ballotpedia.
